import ast,base64,json,pathlib,subprocess,zlib
repo=pathlib.Path('/home/qq/work/chain-cell-native-shard-674c72-20261110')
control=pathlib.Path(str(repo)+'-control')
subprocess.run(['bash','scripts/project-preflight.sh'],cwd=repo,check=True)
tree=ast.parse((control/'apply-docs-grouped-v3.py').read_text())
items=[n.args[0].value for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n,ast.Call) and isinstance(n.func,ast.Attribute) and n.func.attr=='b64decode' and isinstance(n.args[0],ast.Constant)]
assert len(items)==1
old=json.loads(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode(items[0])))
path=repo/'docs/development/specs/pon/CELL_NATIVE_SHARD_RESEARCH_V2.md'
assert path.read_text()==old['doc'], 'concurrent grouped contract modification'
path.write_bytes(zlib.decompress(base64.b64decode('')))
print('GROUPED_FUNDING_RECORD_CONTRACT_UPDATED',flush=True)
